key: EL: As I thought, the door to the innermost sanctum will not open without all four keys.
en: EL: As I thought, the door to the innermost sanctum will not open without all four keys.
ja: エル: 思ったとおり、最奥の聖所の扉は　鍵が四つそろわねば開かぬか。

key: EL: So, Adrienn, you failed to detain them.
en: EL: So, Adrienn, you failed to detain them.
ja: エル: アドリエンヌ、彼らを止められなかったのだな。

key: ADRIENN: I think there are some questions that need to be answered, El.
en: ADRIENN: I think there are some questions that need to be answered, El.
ja: アドリエンヌ: いくつか答えてもらいたいことがあるんだ、エル。

key: EL: This is a holy place.
en: EL: This is a holy place.
ja: エル: ここは聖なる地。

key: This is not the place for trifles such as those.
en: This is not the place for trifles such as those.
ja: そのようなささいな事を持ちこむ場所ではない。

key: Beyond this gate lies that from whose dreams our world unfolds.
en: Beyond this gate lies that from whose dreams our world unfolds.
ja: この門の先に在るは、その夢よりこの世界が生まれし者。

key: Behold, o unworthy ones-- the birthplace of Arceus.
en: Behold, o unworthy ones-- the birthplace of Arceus.
ja: 見よ、卑しき者どもよ——アルセウス生誕の地を。

key: For it is known that the God of Pokémon did create unto the Earth all other species.
en: For it is known that the God of Pokémon did create unto the Earth all other species.
ja: ポケモンの神が　この地上の　あらゆる種を創りしことは　知られておろう。

key: But wherefrom did the divine itself undertake its existence?
en: But wherefrom did the divine itself undertake its existence?
ja: されど、その神自身は　いずこより生を得たのか?

key: For it is known that Pokémon are often found on voyage from space beyond our reach.
en: For it is known that Pokémon are often found on voyage from space beyond our reach.
ja: ポケモンはしばしば　我らの手の届かぬ宇宙より旅して来る。

key: Here, upon our Earth, did a meteor crash, bearing upon it our Lord.
en: Here, upon our Earth, did a meteor crash, bearing upon it our Lord.
ja: ここ、我らの大地に　主を乗せた いん石が落ちたのだ。

key: Here, in this sanctum, doth that very meteor lie.
en: Here, in this sanctum, doth that very meteor lie.
ja: この聖所にこそ　その いん石は眠っている。

key: Yet, how vile it is that it should be buried so far beneath the filth known as Reborn City.
en: Yet, how vile it is that it should be buried so far beneath the filth known as Reborn City.
ja: だが、リボーンシティなる汚泥の下深くに埋もれているとは　なんと忌まわしいことか。

key: My Lord, I beg your forgiveness for humanity's sin.
en: My Lord, I beg your forgiveness for humanity's sin.
ja: 我が主よ、人の罪をお許しください。

key: Ignosco, Venia, Defaeco...
en: Ignosco, Venia, Defaeco...
ja: Ignosco, Venia, Defaeco……

key: EL: And yet, what if the door would open for us?
en: EL: And yet, what if the door would open for us?
ja: エル: だが、もしこの扉が我らに開かれたなら?

key: What if Arceus could be born anew?
en: What if Arceus could be born anew?
ja: もしアルセウスが　再び生まれ出るとしたら?

key: For what might we use its holy power?
en: For what might we use its holy power?
ja: その聖なる力を　我らは何に用いるだろうか?

key: RADOMUS: If anything can be said to be heretical, I believe you've just named it.
en: RADOMUS: If anything can be said to be heretical, I believe you've just named it.
ja: ラドマス: 異端というものがあるとすれば、今きみが口にしたものがそれだろうね。

key: EL: And what does a deceiver as you know of declaiming heresy?
en: EL: And what does a deceiver as you know of declaiming heresy?
ja: エル: 偽りを語る者が　異端を論じるとはな。

key: RADOMUS: Isn't it ironic for you to say that with that Pokémon standing by your side?
en: RADOMUS: Isn't it ironic for you to say that with that Pokémon standing by your side?
ja: ラドマス: そのポケモンを傍らに立たせたまま言うとは　皮肉なものだ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Radomus, I've had more than enough of your constant lying.
en: GARDEVOIR: Radomus, I've had more than enough of your constant lying.
ja: サーナイト: ラドマス、あなたのうそにはもううんざり。

key: Why don't you just admit what you did to poor Luna?!
en: Why don't you just admit what you did to poor Luna?!
ja: かわいそうなルナに何をしたか、いいかげん認めたらどうなの?!

key: EL: Return Luna to me, and I'll return your Gardevoir.
en: EL: Return Luna to me, and I'll return your Gardevoir.
ja: エル: ルナを返せ。さすれば　そのサーナイトも返そう。

key: ADRIENN: If Gardevoir even wants to go back.
en: ADRIENN: If Gardevoir even wants to go back.
ja: アドリエンヌ: サーナイトが戻りたいと思えば、の話だけどね。

key: RADOMUS: If we're going to consider the wishes of those whose custody is questioned, let us not ignore Luna's adamant wish to remain with me.
en: RADOMUS: If we're going to consider the wishes of those whose custody is questioned, let us not ignore Luna's adamant wish to remain with me.
ja: ラドマス: 身柄を争われる者の願いを尊重するというなら、私のもとに残りたいというルナの固い願いも無視できまい。

key: EL: Such a wish is born in falsehood.
en: EL: Such a wish is born in falsehood.
ja: エル: その願いは偽りより生まれたもの。

key: You control her mind to make her say such things!
en: You control her mind to make her say such things!
ja: 貴様が心を操り　そう言わせているのだ!

key: It is the only explanation.
en: It is the only explanation.
ja: それ以外に説明はつかぬ。

key: RADOMUS: Really, what a foolish accusation.
en: RADOMUS: Really, what a foolish accusation.
ja: ラドマス: まったく、ばかげた言いがかりだ。

key: GARDEVOIR: I know it's true though!
en: GARDEVOIR: I know it's true though!
ja: サーナイト: でも本当のことだもの!

key: I was there when you did it!
en: I was there when you did it!
ja: あなたがやったとき、わたしはその場にいたの!

key: Radomus, you are an awful monster!
en: Radomus, you are an awful monster!
ja: ラドマス、あなたはひどい化け物よ!

key: I've always hated being your Pokémon!
en: I've always hated being your Pokémon!
ja: あなたのポケモンでいるのが　ずっと嫌だった!

key: RADOMUS: How long are you going to keep this up?
en: RADOMUS: How long are you going to keep this up?
ja: ラドマス: いつまでそれを続けるつもりかね?

key: CAIN: Don't you even care about your Pokémon's feelings, Radomus?
en: CAIN: Don't you even care about your Pokémon's feelings, Radomus?
ja: カイン: ラドマス、キミは自分のポケモンの気持ちなんてどうでもいいの～?

key: ADRIENN: I'll second that question.
en: ADRIENN: I'll second that question.
ja: アドリエンヌ: わたしもそれを聞きたい。

key: You really don't seem affected by her words at all.
en: You really don't seem affected by her words at all.
ja: 彼女の言葉に　まるで動じていないように見えるよ。

key: RADOMUS: A Pokémon like that?
en: RADOMUS: A Pokémon like that?
ja: ラドマス: あんなポケモンが?

key: Why should I care?
en: Why should I care?
ja: 気にする理由がどこにある?

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh! He says such cruel things!
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh! He says such cruel things!
ja: サーナイト: ああ! なんてひどいことを言うの!

key: Adrienn, please protect me from him!
en: Adrienn, please protect me from him!
ja: アドリエンヌ、この人からわたしを守って!

key: CAIN: I don't want to believe it, but maybe Radomus really did brainwash Luna...
en: CAIN: I don't want to believe it, but maybe Radomus really did brainwash Luna...
ja: カイン: 信じたくないけど、ラドマスは本当にルナを洗脳したのかも……

key: EL: He is a callous and two-faced swine who has no moral compass.
en: EL: He is a callous and two-faced swine who has no moral compass.
ja: エル: この者は情を持たぬ二枚舌の豚。道徳の方位磁石を持たぬ男だ。

key: RADOMUS: Better no compass at all than one that points south.
en: RADOMUS: Better no compass at all than one that points south.
ja: ラドマス: 南を指す磁石を持つくらいなら、磁石など無いほうがましだよ。

key: ADRIENN: One of the best measures of a person's worth is how they treat those in their power.
en: ADRIENN: One of the best measures of a person's worth is how they treat those in their power.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 人の価値は、自分の力の下にある者をどう扱うかによく表れる。

key: Your Gardevoir truly seems to resent you, Radomus.
en: Your Gardevoir truly seems to resent you, Radomus.
ja: きみのサーナイトは　本当にきみを恨んでいるように見える、ラドマス。

key: I cannot agree that she should be returned to you.
en: I cannot agree that she should be returned to you.
ja: この子をきみに返すことには賛成できない。

key: RADOMUS: Well, I'm sorry you feel that way, Adrienn.
en: RADOMUS: Well, I'm sorry you feel that way, Adrienn.
ja: ラドマス: そう感じさせてしまったのなら申し訳ないね、アドリエンヌ。

key: ADRIENN: The way you say that, it's not an apology at all.
en: ADRIENN: The way you say that, it's not an apology at all.
ja: アドリエンヌ: その言い方じゃ　まるで謝罪になっていないよ。

key: RADOMUS: Perhaps it is better judged by those who met Gardevoir with Luna.
en: RADOMUS: Perhaps it is better judged by those who met Gardevoir with Luna.
ja: ラドマス: ならば、ルナと共にいたサーナイトに会った者たちに　判断してもらおうか。

key: CAIN: You mean you're asking whose side we're taking?
en: CAIN: You mean you're asking whose side we're taking?
ja: カイン: つまり　どっちの味方につくか聞いてるってこと～?

key: RADOMUS: If you choose to view it that way.
en: RADOMUS: If you choose to view it that way.
ja: ラドマス: そう捉えたいのならね。

key: CAIN: I don't know.
en: CAIN: I don't know.
ja: カイン: わかんないよ。

key: You don't seem to care at all about Gardevoir, and you certainly didn't react when she was taken.
en: You don't seem to care at all about Gardevoir, and you certainly didn't react when she was taken.
ja: キミはサーナイトのことを全然気にしてないみたいだし、連れて行かれたときも何の反応もしなかった。

key: You made jokes instead.
en: You made jokes instead.
ja: 代わりに冗談を言ってたよね。

key: On the other hand, Luna really seems to want to stay with you, but that could just be a trick.
en: On the other hand, Luna really seems to want to stay with you, but that could just be a trick.
ja: でも一方で、ルナは本当にキミといたがってるみたいだし……それも仕掛けかもしれないけど。

key: And honestly, I had enough of being lied to after Ace.
en: And honestly, I had enough of being lied to after Ace.
ja: 正直、エースの件で　うそをつかれるのはもうたくさんなんだ。

key: Ugh... I don't get it at all.
en: Ugh... I don't get it at all.
ja: うう……ボクにはさっぱりだよ。

key: \PN, what do you think?
en: \PN, what do you think?
ja: \PN、キミはどう思う?

key: CAIN: \PN, what do you think?
en: CAIN: \PN, what do you think?
ja: カイン: \PN、キミはどう思う?

key: Should we side with El, or with Radomus?
en: Should we side with El, or with Radomus?
ja: エルとラドマス、どっちにつくべきかな?

key: RADOMUS: I'm disappointed, \PN.
en: RADOMUS: I'm disappointed, \PN.
ja: ラドマス: 失望したよ、\PN。

key: I had thought you might have been able to tell the difference, since you met her before.
en: I had thought you might have been able to tell the difference, since you met her before.
ja: 以前に会っているのだから、違いに気づけると思っていたのだがね。

key: ADRIENN: What are you talking about?
en: ADRIENN: What are you talking about?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 何の話をしているの?

key: RADOMUS: \PN, Cain, didn't Gardevoir act a little differently with me than since we came here?
en: RADOMUS: \PN, Cain, didn't Gardevoir act a little differently with me than since we came here?
ja: ラドマス: \PN、カイン。サーナイトは私のところにいたときと　ここへ来てからとで　少し様子が違わなかったかね?

key: CAIN: She said that's just because she was putting on a facade the whole time though.
en: CAIN: She said that's just because she was putting on a facade the whole time though.
ja: カイン: それはずっと演技してたからだって　本人が言ってたじゃない～

key: RADOMUS: Ah, that could be the case.
en: RADOMUS: Ah, that could be the case.
ja: ラドマス: ああ、それもありうる。

key: Or it could be because that's not my Gardevoir.
en: Or it could be because that's not my Gardevoir.
ja: あるいは、それが私のサーナイトではないからかもしれない。

key: Isn't it, El?
en: Isn't it, El?
ja: そうだろう、エル?

key: CAIN: Huh?
en: CAIN: Huh?
ja: カイン: え?

key: ADRIENN: What? But she said...
en: ADRIENN: What? But she said...
ja: アドリエンヌ: 何? でも、この子は……

key: EL: So you knew all along, did you?
en: EL: So you knew all along, did you?
ja: エル: 最初から気づいていたか。

key: ADRIENN: Wait, that's--
en: ADRIENN: Wait, that's--
ja: アドリエンヌ: 待って、それは——

key: CAIN: She was a Ditto all along?!
en: CAIN: She was a Ditto all along?!
ja: カイン: 最初からメタモンだったの?!

key: RADOMUS: Unlike the riddles in this ruin's towers, light and truth do not always go hand-in-hand.
en: RADOMUS: Unlike the riddles in this ruin's towers, light and truth do not always go hand-in-hand.
ja: ラドマス: この遺跡の塔の謎かけとは違い、光と真実は必ずしも手を取り合わない。

key: As I'm sure our friend Adrienn can attest to, things don't neatly fit into black and white categories.
en: As I'm sure our friend Adrienn can attest to, things don't neatly fit into black and white categories.
ja: アドリエンヌなら分かるだろうが、物事はきれいに白黒には分かれないのだよ。

key: Sometimes, light can be even more blinding than darkness.
en: Sometimes, light can be even more blinding than darkness.
ja: 時に光は　闇よりも目をくらませる。

key: And I, for one, think it would have been silly to be taken in by the dramatic confession of a false Pokémon.
en: And I, for one, think it would have been silly to be taken in by the dramatic confession of a false Pokémon.
ja: 偽物のポケモンの芝居がかった告白に　だまされるなど　私には愚かしく思えたのでね。

key: That's why I was uninterested.
en: That's why I was uninterested.
ja: だから私は興味を示さなかった。

key: EL: You are as obstinate as ever, Radomus.
en: EL: You are as obstinate as ever, Radomus.
ja: エル: 相変わらず強情な男だ、ラドマス。

key: Do not speak to me of blindness.
en: Do not speak to me of blindness.
ja: 盲目について　私に語るな。

key: CAIN: Wait-- your eyes.
en: CAIN: Wait-- your eyes.
ja: カイン: 待って——その目……

key: You're not...?
en: You're not...?
ja: まさか、キミは……?

key: EL: I once was.
en: EL: I once was.
ja: エル: かつてはそうだった。

key: Yet no sooner did I undertake a prayer to the Lord Arceus did he bless me with my vision.
en: Yet no sooner did I undertake a prayer to the Lord Arceus did he bless me with my vision.
ja: だが主アルセウスに祈りを ささげるや否や、主は我に視力を授けられた。

key: I have followed his name ever since.
en: I have followed his name ever since.
ja: 以来、我はその御名に従ってきた。

key: Now, I will deign to borrow his power.
en: Now, I will deign to borrow his power.
ja: 今こそ、その力を借り受けよう。

key: Can you feel it? The holy energy that charges this place?
en: Can you feel it? The holy energy that charges this place?
ja: 感じるか? この場に満ちる　聖なるエネルギーを

key: It emanates from the stone of Arceus.
en: It emanates from the stone of Arceus.
ja: それはアルセウスの石より発している。

key: Ditto.
en: Ditto.
ja: メタモン。

key: Embrace the Lord's blessing.
en: Embrace the Lord's blessing.
ja: 主の祝福を受け入れよ。

key: Take the energy into thyself!
en: Take the energy into thyself!
ja: その力を　その身に取りこむのだ!

key: Opprimo Oppressi Oppressum!
en: Opprimo Oppressi Oppressum!
ja: Opprimo Oppressi Oppressum!

key: EL: Aduro, Creo, Iudex... Mei Divinitus!
en: EL: Aduro, Creo, Iudex... Mei Divinitus!
ja: エル: Aduro, Creo, Iudex…… Mei Divinitus!

key: We will silence all heretics!
en: We will silence all heretics!
ja: 異端者はすべて黙らせる!

key: Let judgment rain down upon thee!
en: Let judgment rain down upon thee!
ja: その身に裁きを降らせん!

key: Thou defiest me; thou defiest the Lord.
en: Thou defiest me; thou defiest the Lord.
ja: 我に逆らう者は　主に逆らう者だ。

key: EL: As but a false idol, it cannot hope to mimic the true Lord's power.
en: EL: As but a false idol, it cannot hope to mimic the true Lord's power.
ja: エル: 偽りの偶像ごときが　真の主の力を真似られるはずもない。

key: RADOMUS: Is that all, then?
en: RADOMUS: Is that all, then?
ja: ラドマス: それで終わりかね?

key: CAIN: Wait, so if that was Ditto, then where is the real Gardevoir?
en: CAIN: Wait, so if that was Ditto, then where is the real Gardevoir?
ja: カイン: 待って、あれがメタモンなら　本物のサーナイトはどこにいるの?

key: RADOMUS: Where, indeed?
en: RADOMUS: Where, indeed?
ja: ラドマス: さて、どこだろうね。

key: It looks like it's my move now.
en: It looks like it's my move now.
ja: どうやら　次は私の手番のようだ。

key: RADOMUS: Gardevoir!
en: RADOMUS: Gardevoir!
ja: ラドマス: サーナイト!

key: Teleport, now.
en: Teleport, now.
ja: テレポート、今だ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Ta-daaa!
en: GARDEVOIR: Ta-daaa!
ja: サーナイト: じゃじゃーん!

key: EL: I trust my power is now demonstrated.
en: EL: I trust my power is now demonstrated.
ja: エル: 我が力、示されたはずだ。

key: Yet, as you elected to side with me, I will show you the Lord's mercy.
en: Yet, as you elected to side with me, I will show you the Lord's mercy.
ja: だが、そなたは我の側についた。主の慈悲を示そう。

key: As for the others...
en: As for the others...
ja: 他の者たちは……

key: RADOMUS: I think that's about enough.
en: RADOMUS: I think that's about enough.
ja: ラドマス: そのあたりで十分だろう。

key: I believe it's my move now.
en: I believe it's my move now.
ja: 次は私の手番のはずだ。

key: EL: What? How?
en: EL: What? How?
ja: エル: 何? どうやって?

key: CAIN: All right. I'll trust you on that one, \PN.
en: CAIN: All right. I'll trust you on that one, \PN.
ja: カイン: わかった。それについてはキミを信じるよ、\PN。

key: RADOMUS: Very good.
en: RADOMUS: Very good.
ja: ラドマス: よろしい。

key: I am relieved that I am not the only one to whom this charade is transparent.
en: I am relieved that I am not the only one to whom this charade is transparent.
ja: この茶番を見抜いていたのが私だけでないとは、安心したよ。

key: ADRIENN: Charade? What are you talking about?
en: ADRIENN: Charade? What are you talking about?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 茶番? 何の話だい?

key: RADOMUS: Adrienn, your main reason for siding with El is the testimony of my Gardevoir, correct?
en: RADOMUS: Adrienn, your main reason for siding with El is the testimony of my Gardevoir, correct?
ja: ラドマス: アドリエンヌ、きみがエルの側についた主な理由は　私のサーナイトの証言だろう?

key: However, that's a foolish basis.
en: However, that's a foolish basis.
ja: だが、それは愚かな根拠だ。

key: After all, you've never met her.
en: After all, you've never met her.
ja: 何しろ、きみは彼女に会ったことがない。

key: ADRIENN: But she's... right there.
en: ADRIENN: But she's... right there.
ja: アドリエンヌ: でも、この子はすぐそこに……

key: RADOMUS: Is she, really?
en: RADOMUS: Is she, really?
ja: ラドマス: 本当にそうかな?

key: El?
en: El?
ja: エル?

key: ADRIENN: ...What?
en: ADRIENN: ...What?
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……何?

key: CAIN: It was a Ditto this whole time?!
en: CAIN: It was a Ditto this whole time?!
ja: カイン: 最初からずっとメタモンだったの?!

key: We will silence the heretics!
en: We will silence the heretics!
ja: 異端者を黙らせる!

key: ADRIENN: So that's the real Gardevoir...
en: ADRIENN: So that's the real Gardevoir...
ja: アドリエンヌ: あれが本物のサーナイト……

key: GARDEVOIR: At your service~
en: GARDEVOIR: At your service~
ja: サーナイト: お呼びとあらば～

key: Miss me?
en: Miss me?
ja: 会いたかった?

key: RADOMUS: Dearly.
en: RADOMUS: Dearly.
ja: ラドマス: 心から。

key: But we're not done yet.
en: But we're not done yet.
ja: だが、まだ終わりではない。

key: Gardevoir, Hypnosis.
en: Gardevoir, Hypnosis.
ja: サーナイト、さいみんじゅつ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Yeees, Master!
en: GARDEVOIR: Yeees, Master!
ja: サーナイト: はぁーい、マスター!

key: GARDEVOIR: Good night! Mwah!
en: GARDEVOIR: Good night! Mwah!
ja: サーナイト: おやすみなさい! ちゅっ!

key: GARDEVOIR: It's a One-Hit KO!
en: GARDEVOIR: It's a One-Hit KO!
ja: サーナイト: 一撃必殺!

key: RADOMUS: Indeed.
en: RADOMUS: Indeed.
ja: ラドマス: そのとおり。

key: That about makes this case closed.
en: That about makes this case closed.
ja: これで一件落着といったところだ。

key: RADOMUS: We'll take this one back down to the station.
en: RADOMUS: We'll take this one back down to the station.
ja: ラドマス: この男は署へ連れて行く。

key: He has some time to do.
en: He has some time to do.
ja: しばらく務めてもらうことになる。

key: CAIN: Wait, I don't get it.
en: CAIN: Wait, I don't get it.
ja: カイン: 待って、わかんないよ。

key: If you could have just had Gardevoir Teleport at any time, why bother coming all the way down here?
en: If you could have just had Gardevoir Teleport at any time, why bother coming all the way down here?
ja: いつでもサーナイトにテレポートさせられたなら、なんでわざわざここまで降りてきたの?

key: RADOMUS: I hadn't said before?
en: RADOMUS: I hadn't said before?
ja: ラドマス: 言っていなかったかね?

key: Simply because Luna asked me to.
en: Simply because Luna asked me to.
ja: 単に、ルナがそう頼んだからだよ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Yup! I could've escaped at any time~
en: GARDEVOIR: Yup! I could've escaped at any time~
ja: サーナイト: そうなの! いつでも逃げられたのよ～

key: But ohh, my darling Master, save me!
en: But ohh, my darling Master, save me!
ja: でもぉ、愛しのマスター、助けて!

key: Don't I make a compelling damsel in distress~?
en: Don't I make a compelling damsel in distress~?
ja: とらわれのお姫様、なかなか様になってたでしょ～?

key: ADRIENN: This Gardevoir is certainly more lively.
en: ADRIENN: This Gardevoir is certainly more lively.
ja: アドリエンヌ: こっちのサーナイトは　ずいぶん元気だね。

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh yeah, you were all "I will protect you!" and stuff~
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh yeah, you were all "I will protect you!" and stuff~
ja: サーナイト: そうそう、あなた「守ってあげる!」とか言ってたわよね～

key: You're a cutie!
en: You're a cutie!
ja: かわいいんだから!

key: But I would never leave my master.
en: But I would never leave my master.
ja: でも、わたしがマスターから離れることは絶対にないの。

key: He's perfect as is!
en: He's perfect as is!
ja: この人はそのままで完璧なんだから!

key: ADRIENN: ...Heh. Well, I'm relieved.
en: ADRIENN: ...Heh. Well, I'm relieved.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……ふふ。まあ、安心したよ。

key: RADOMUS: As I asked in the first place,
en: RADOMUS: As I asked in the first place,
ja: ラドマス: 最初に言ったとおり、

key: Why should I be concerned when the opposing king places himself in check?
en: Why should I be concerned when the opposing king places himself in check?
ja: 相手の王が自ら王手をかけられに来るのに、なぜ私が案じる必要がある?

key: El tried to strike at me by using Gardevoir, but it was his mistake in underestimating her.
en: El tried to strike at me by using Gardevoir, but it was his mistake in underestimating her.
ja: エルはサーナイトを使って私を打とうとしたが、彼女を見くびったのが誤りだった。

key: GARDEVOIR: Please, hold your applause for me until we're back in the comfort of home!
en: GARDEVOIR: Please, hold your applause for me until we're back in the comfort of home!
ja: サーナイト: 拍手はおうちに帰ってからにしてね!

key: RADOMUS: On that note, I think it's about time we picked ourselves up out of here.
en: RADOMUS: On that note, I think it's about time we picked ourselves up out of here.
ja: ラドマス: さて、そろそろここから引き上げる ころ合いだ。

key: Shall we all leave together?
en: Shall we all leave together?
ja: みんなで一緒に出るとしようか?

key: RADOMUS: It should be just a quick teleport out.
en: RADOMUS: It should be just a quick teleport out.
ja: ラドマス: テレポートひとつで　すぐ外に出られるはずだ。

key: RADOMUS: As you will.
en: RADOMUS: As you will.
ja: ラドマス: 好きにしたまえ。

key: It should be just a quick teleport out.
en: It should be just a quick teleport out.
ja: テレポートひとつで　すぐ外に出られるはずだ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Something about this place makes teleports so muddy...
en: GARDEVOIR: Something about this place makes teleports so muddy...
ja: サーナイト: この場所、なんだかテレポートが濁るのよね……

key: I don't think I can get us all the way, but I can at least take us out of this old cave!
en: I don't think I can get us all the way, but I can at least take us out of this old cave!
ja: 全部の道のりは無理だけど、せめてこの古いどうくつの外までは連れて行けるわ!

key: RADOMUS: Better than hiking, perhaps.
en: RADOMUS: Better than hiking, perhaps.
ja: ラドマス: 歩くよりはましだろうね。

key: Let us be off.
en: Let us be off.
ja: 行くとしよう。

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh, now... Shall we begin?
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh, now... Shall we begin?
ja: サーナイト: さあ……始めましょうか?

key: The inner sanctum door remains sealed tight...
en: The inner sanctum door remains sealed tight...
ja: 最奥の聖所の扉は　固く閉ざされたままだ……

key: The doors have sealed shut again...
en: The doors have sealed shut again...
ja: 扉はふたたび　固く閉じてしまった……

key: ...The Ebony Stonepiece reacts!
en: ...The Ebony Stonepiece reacts!
ja: ……エボニーのいしのかけらが　反応した!

key: The doors click open!
en: The doors click open!
ja: 扉がカチリと開いた!

key: LIN: This door was opened with the seal outside.
en: LIN: This door was opened with the seal outside.
ja: リン: この扉は　外の封印によって開かれました。

key: With it, the New World has been tethered to the old.
en: With it, the New World has been tethered to the old.
ja: それにより、新世界は古い世界へとつながれたのです。

key: What needed to be done, has been.
en: What needed to be done, has been.
ja: なされるべきことは　なされました。

key: Bridges, like boundaries, are made to be crossed.
en: Bridges, like boundaries, are made to be crossed.
ja: 橋は境界と同じく、渡られるためにあるもの。

key: Some go much too far.
en: Some go much too far.
ja: 行きすぎる者もいますが。

key: Even a wildfire knows when it is time to burn out.
en: Even a wildfire knows when it is time to burn out.
ja: 野火でさえ　燃え尽きるときを知っています。

key: I knew it was mine long ago.
en: I knew it was mine long ago.
ja: わたくしは　とうにその時を知っていました。

key: LIN: Once upon a time, a little girl was trapped here.
en: LIN: Once upon a time, a little girl was trapped here.
ja: リン: むかしむかし、ひとりの少女がここに閉じこめられていました。

key: Her only company was an old, forgotten meteor.
en: Her only company was an old, forgotten meteor.
ja: 連れといえば　忘れられた古い いん石だけ。

key: Great company it was, for still it housed the seed of a God.
en: Great company it was, for still it housed the seed of a God.
ja: それは素晴らしい連れでした。神の種を宿していたのですから。

key: Like her own, she raised it.
en: Like her own, she raised it.
ja: 少女はそれを　我が子のように育てました。

key: Like its own, it blessed her.
en: Like its own, it blessed her.
ja: それは少女を　我が子のように祝福しました。

key: Soon, there were few limits to what she could do.
en: Soon, there were few limits to what she could do.
ja: やがて、少女にできぬことは　ほとんど無くなりました。

key: Absolute power is a toy as dangerous as it is boring.
en: Absolute power is a toy as dangerous as it is boring.
ja: 絶対の力とは、危険であると同時に退屈な　おもちゃです。

key: Games are no fun without an opponent.
en: Games are no fun without an opponent.
ja: 遊びは　相手がいなければ面白くありません。

key: Lucky then, that there was one.
en: Lucky then, that there was one.
ja: 幸いにも、相手はいました。

key: You will end this game, or prove it meaningless.
en: You will end this game, or prove it meaningless.
ja: あなたはこの遊びを終わらせる。さもなくば　無意味だと証明する。

key: The next step into this world belongs to you.
en: The next step into this world belongs to you.
ja: この世界への次の一歩は　あなたのものです。

key: You will take it because you need know what happens next.
en: You will take it because you need know what happens next.
ja: あなたは踏み出すでしょう。次に何が起こるか　知らずにはいられないのだから。

key: LIN: We do not expect you to understand.
en: LIN: We do not expect you to understand.
ja: リン: 理解してもらおうとは思いません。

key: We simply invite you to the show.
en: We simply invite you to the show.
ja: ただ、この見世物へ　あなたを招くだけ。

key: You will be the next to cross the boundary.
en: You will be the next to cross the boundary.
ja: 次に境界を越えるのは　あなたです。

key: You will do it because you need know what happens next.
en: You will do it because you need know what happens next.
ja: あなたはそうするでしょう。次に何が起こるか　知らずにはいられないのだから。

key: El
en: El
ja: エル

key: Radomus
en: Radomus
ja: ラドマス

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
